Subject: Interactive kickstart runbook + next steps (prompt routing & load tests)

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short hands-on kickstart so your engineers can exercise prompt routing, review our suggested prompts, and run a short load window to validate throughput. Proposed agenda (90 min):

- 10 min: quick introductions + goals
- 20 min: prompt deck walkthrough & prompt engineering Qs
- 30 min: routing policy demo (region/fallback/cost tiers) + configuration walk-through
- 20 min: controlled load test (up to 100 concurrent RPS for 10 min) + observability walkthrough
- 10 min: immediate action items & next session schedule

Two slot options:
- Tue Oct 6, 11:00–12:30 PDT (preferred)
- Wed Oct 7, 14:00–15:30 PDT

Pre-reqs:
- SSH access to one test VM (we'll provide a short provisioning script)
- Sample prompt set (attach if you have one)
- One engineer who can review routing rules during the session

I've attached the draft kickstart runbook (kickstart-runbook-v1.pdf) and a short loadtest plan. Please let me know which slot works and who from your side will join (names and emails).

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for this — both slots look doable. Can we lock Tue Oct 6, 11:00–12:30 PDT? Tom (platform lead) will join — adding him here.

A couple quick Qs before the session:
- For the controlled load test, what does Redwood expect on concurrency/connection handling from our infra? Our default test harness supports up to 200 concurrent connections but we'd prefer to start lower.
- Do you need us to scrub any PII in the sample prompts? We can provide a redacted set.

I'll upload a redacted prompt pack to poc@helixai.com by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Samira

All —

Thanks for circulating the runbook. A few operational notes before we lock the slot:

1) Owners:
   - Prompt review & redaction guidance: Avery (I can back you up) — deliverable: redaction checklist by Mon Oct 4
   - Routing policy walkthrough & demo config: Olga — will prepare a small sample policy and be ready to push it to the test cluster
   - Load test orchestration: Ben — I'll coordinate with infra to reserve a single GPU node and the temporary test VM (we should be able to simulate ~150 RPS from one node).

2) Load profile: agree with Samira to start at 50 RPS warmup, 10 min peak at 120 RPS, then cool-down — keeps things safe for their infra and gives us telemetry. Will include a table in loadtest-plan.csv.

3) Access: Hannah, please share the provisioning script and default SSH key location. Samira, we'll need the test VM IP (or we can provision in your VPC; let me know preferred approach).

4) Recording & notes: we'll record the session and drop a short transcript + the session-notes-template.docx into the Drive link attached in the runbook.

I've updated a couple small items on the runbook and attached the updated CSV locally.

Ben
